# T-4: Load review metrics artifacts

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Build the artifact scanner and domain classes that load specs, issue-log entries, review findings, repair references, and missing-data states.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Scanner reads all matching `specs/*` directories
- Scanner reads flow.json retry metrics when present
- Missing files produce explicit not-recorded state instead of crashes
- Domain classes enforce required ids, phases, categories, and unknown status invariants

## Implementation Notes
Use classes for loaded specs, normalized findings, repair outcomes, retry states, aggregate rows, and missing-data markers. Do not model report values as `{ type: ... }` object literals.

## Test Strategy
Unit tests with fixture specs covering complete data, missing review history, malformed optional files, and partial repair references.
